subject: E-Commerce
title: Etsy: Handmade Goes Corporate
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Etsy: Handmade Goes Corporate.

hook.text: Etsy grew to $13 billion in sales by promising handmade and unique products. Then mass producers flooded the platform.

buildup.text: Etsy started as a marketplace for artisans. Handmade jewelry, custom art, and vintage goods defined its identity.

discovery.text: Sellers using print-on-demand and dropshipping now dominate Etsy. Many 'handmade' items are factory-produced.

twist.text: Real artisans complain their listings drown in mass-produced fakes. The platform's identity crisis hurts its original.

climax.text: Etsy's dilemma: enforce handmade rules and shrink revenue, or allow mass production and lose what makes it special.

punchline.text: $13B in sales, but 'handmade' diluted. Etsy grew by letting in exactly what it.

quiz.question: What is Etsy's main identity crisis?
options: Mass-produced items flooding a platform built for handmade and artisan goods
